answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 4253 Country: India Title: In dream I saw That I m killing a person who had killed many other muslim i.e. I was taking revenge what does it mean. As marrying uncle's wife is jaiz after his death but what if she is my maternal aunt. Many A time I see Mosque in my dream Question: In dream I saw That I m killing a person who had killed many other muslim i.e. I was taking revenge what does it mean. (2) As marrying uncle's wife is jaiz after his death but what if she is my maternal aunt. (3) Many A time I see Mosque in my dream. Answer ID: 4253 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1133/822=H/1429) (1) It means that Allah will enable you to perform such actions which will benefit all people; Muslims and non-Muslims. (2) One can marry the widow of his uncle (maternal or paternal) after she passes the iddah . (3) This is also a good dream. Seeing mosque in dream means that you will be granted safety of your imaan and belief. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
